html:
Peter Kenilorea was a teacher from Malaita who led the Solomon Islands to independence on 7 July 1978 and served as its first prime minister.

He took over the last stage of self-government from the British protectorate and kept the new state within the Commonwealth. He served twice as prime minister and later as speaker of parliament, through the years of the Tensions.

He is remembered as the father of the nation, beside Walter Lini of Vanuatu and Michael Somare of Papua New Guinea.
sum: Peter Kenilorea was a teacher from Malaita who led the Solomon Islands to independence on 7 July 1978 and served as its first prime minister.
